title: web-modernize migration state (top-level)
description: Schema for .claude/modernize/state.json — the top-level workflow ledger. Per-unit state lives in .claude/modernize/units/<id>.json (see unit.schema.json).

schema_version.description: Increment when the top-level state shape changes. The plugin does not migrate forward — a schema_version mismatch requires deleting .claude/modernize/ and running /web-modernize:init.

plugin_version.description: Version of the web-modernize plugin that last wrote this file.

uses_external_source.description: Team-wide fact (not a path): whether the legacy (source) tree lives outside this target/working repo. Set by /web-modernize:analyze from migration.md's 'Legacy source in a separate repo/folder?' toggle. The actual filesystem path is deliberately NOT stored here (it is machine-specific) — it lives only in the gitignored, per-developer .claude/modernize/source_root.local.json (see skills/_shared/source-root-resolve.md). false/absent means source and target are the same repo (the working directory) — the pre-existing behaviour, unchanged.

source_repo.description: Optional provenance for the external legacy repo (mirrors `repo`) — a remote URL + commit SHA is the same for every teammate, unlike the local path, so it is safe to share via git. Populated by /web-modernize:analyze when the resolved external source_root (per the developer's local source_root.local.json) is itself a git repo; omitted otherwise.

status.description: Top-level workflow phase. Drives which skill is eligible to run next.

ui.description: e.g. react-vite-ts, next-app-router, vue3-vite, angular, svelte-kit

api.description: e.g. dotnet-minimal-api, spring-boot-3, nestjs, fastapi, reuse-existing, none

review_mode.description: Migration-wide default for the per-unit plan-approval gate used by /next, /migrate, /retry. 'plan-first' (the default — also assumed when this field is absent) presents each unit's plan and waits for approval before writing; 'auto' skips the gate. Set optionally at /plan; a per-unit --plan / --no-plan flag overrides it for a single unit. (The /foundation design gate is always-on and independent of this setting.)

foundation.description: The set of cross-cutting concerns the team confirmed at /plan, established as the foundational slice by /web-modernize:foundation (which replaces the old /auth command). 'auth' is always present; others are opt-in via migration.md §13.

concerns.description: Concern ids to establish. Each maps to a synthetic unit __<concern>__ (auth keeps kind 'service'; others kind 'cross-cutting'). 'data' establishes data-access WIRING only (ORM/client/connection/migration harness) — the bulk schema/query/proc translation is a separate later phase.

integration.description: Composed-app integration state, written by /web-modernize:integrate (an idempotent reconciliation runnable at any stage). Does not change top-level status.

router_path.description: The central router file the integrate step reconciles.

nav_path.description: The nav/menu file assembled from migrated routes.

strangler_config_path.description: Reverse-proxy / route-table file, present only when strategy is strangler-fig.

orphaned_units.description: Migrated units with no route / unreachable from nav.

coverage_pct.description: Share of in-scope routes now served by the new app (cutover progress).

testing.description: Source of truth for which test runner /scaffold installs and which coverage bar /verify and the unit-migrator measure against. Seeded by /plan from migration.md §12.

api_framework.description: e.g. pytest, vitest, xunit, or 'n/a' when API is none/reuse-existing

unit_ids.description: Ordered list of migration unit ids. Each id corresponds to .claude/modernize/units/<id>.json. The order defines the canonical plan ordering used by /web-modernize:next.

open_decisions.description: Cross-cutting architectural decisions the team must make (e.g. one responsive layout vs. a separate mobile component tree, state-management approach, routing strategy). Collected by /web-modernize:plan and surfaced at its approval gate; unit-migrator refuses to resolve an unresolved one unilaterally and records the chosen option here so it is decided once for the whole migration.

question.description: The decision to be made, in plain language.

decision.description: The chosen option; present when status == resolved.

affects.description: Optional: unit ids or areas this decision bears on.

lock.description: Advisory lock for full-repo operations (plan, scaffold). null when no lock held.
